percentage.description: The speed percentage of the fan

tools.name: homeassistant__GetLiveContext
tools.description: Provides real-time information about the CURRENT state, value, or mode of devices, sensors, entities, or areas. Use this tool for: 1. Answering questions about current conditions (e.g., 'Is the light on?'). 2. As the first step in conditional actions (e.g., 'If the weather is rainy, turn off sprinklers' requires checking the weather first). You may filter for devices by name, domain, and area, including combining those filters. Prefer filtering by domain when searching for multiple devices of the same type.

name.description: Filter entities by name or alias (case-insensitive).

domain.description: Filter entities by domain (e.g. 'light', 'sensor'). Accepts a single domain or a list.

area.description: Filter entities by area name or alias (case-insensitive).

tools.name: humidifier__HassHumidifierSetpoint
tools.description: Set desired humidity level

tools.name: humidifier__HassHumidifierMode
tools.description: Set humidifier mode

tools.name: intent__HassTurnOn
tools.description: Turns on/opens/presses a device or entity. For locks, this performs a 'lock' action. Use for requests like 'turn on', 'activate', 'enable', or 'lock'.

tools.name: intent__HassTurnOff
tools.description: Turns off/closes a device or entity. For locks, this performs an 'unlock' action. Use for requests like 'turn off', 'deactivate', 'disable', or 'unlock'.

tools.name: intent__HassSetPosition
tools.description: Sets the position of a device or entity

tools.name: intent__HassStopMoving
tools.description: Stops a moving device or entity

tools.name: intent__HassCancelAllTimers
tools.description: Cancels all timers

tools.name: light__HassLightSet
tools.description: Sets the brightness percentage or color of a light

brightness.description: The brightness percentage of the light between 0 and 100, where 0 is off and 100 is fully lit

tools.name: llm__GetDateTime
tools.description: Provides the current date and time.

tools.description: Resumes a media player

tools.name: media_player__HassMediaPause
tools.description: Pauses a media player

tools.name: media_player__HassMediaNext
tools.description: Skips a media player to the next item

tools.name: media_player__HassMediaPrevious
tools.description: Replays the previous item for a media player

tools.name: media_player__HassSetVolume
tools.description: Sets the volume percentage of a media player

volume_level.description: The volume percentage of the media player

tools.name: media_player__HassSetVolumeRelative
tools.description: Increases or decreases the volume of a media player

tools.name: media_player__HassMediaPlayerMute
tools.description: Mutes a media player

is_volume_muted.description: Whether the media player should be muted or unmuted

tools.name: media_player__HassMediaPlayerUnmute
tools.description: Unmutes a media player

is_volume_muted.description: Whether the media player should be muted or unmuted

tools.name: media_player__HassMediaSearchAndPlay
tools.description: Searches for media and plays the first result

tools.description: Query a to-do list to find out what items are on it. Use this to answer questions like 'What's on my task list?' or 'Read my grocery list'. Filters items by status (needs_action, completed, all).

status.description: Filter returned items by status, by default returns incomplete items

tools.description: Add item to a todo list

tools.name: todo__HassListCompleteItem
tools.description: Complete item on a todo list

tools.name: todo__HassListRemoveItem
tools.description: Remove one or more items from a todo list

tools.description: Starts a vacuum

tools.name: vacuum__HassVacuumReturnToBase
tools.description: Returns a vacuum to base

tools.name: vacuum__HassVacuumCleanArea
tools.description: Tells a vacuum to clean a specific area
